_comment: RECORDED RESULTS FOR THE NAMED MANUAL CHECKS in scripts/checks/dfu-done.ps1.
A clause that cannot be machine-evaluated is printed by that script as a NAMED manual
check and lands in the refusing bucket 'manual_pending' until a result appears HERE
under that exact name. There is no path from 'unrecorded' to 'fine'.
A record is only a result when it carries ALL FOUR fields. A record missing any of
them is a note somebody left, not a check somebody ran, and dfu-done.ps1 ignores it:
verdict   'pass' or 'fail' - what the check actually returned
by        WHO ran it. Per the merge protocol this must not be the person who built
evidence  what they saw - a command and its output, a file:line, a permalink.
THIS FILE IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY OF RESULTS. Adding an entry here that nobody ran is
the same defect as amending a plan column to get a green, one file over.
